reading.title: Commerce Department under pressure for delaying export controls on Nvidia chips
reading.summary: The U.S. Commerce Department is under scrutiny for clearing Chinese companies to handle Nvidia chips, despite national security concerns from cabinet officials and U.S. intelligence agencies.

news.title: Kuwait says it repelled first Iranian attack in two months after US strikes island
news.summary: Bahrain says it was also attacked by Iran following a US air strike on the Iranian island of Qeshm in the Gulf on Tuesday.
